title: Calgary Centennial Planetarium heritage retrofit project profile
code_edition: Unknown (the profile refers to current building codes but names no edition)

facts.text: The profile identifies the 1967 Centennial Planetarium at 701 11th Street SW, City of Calgary as owner, and describes conversion to a contemporary art gallery with heritage conservation. It says the renovation was intended to address current building codes but does not identify an edition or attach the code analysis.
The article reports unknown concealed/as-built structural conditions; following a roof leak, 3D laser scanning was used to model a damaged atrium ceiling.

RJC’s quoted structural consultant says it assessed the structural impact of cutting more than 200 service cores. The article says tracing existing services and pathways involved experienced guesswork and testing.

The article describes heating/HVAC and electrical upgrades and quotes a lighting designer reporting modern fire alarms and life-safety lighting “now up to code”; that is a project-profile statement, not a supplied approval or independent code finding.
